name: Berto Acquisition Corp. Unit
summary: Berto Acquisition Corp. is established as a special purpose acquisition company, meaning it does not currently operate any specific business. Its core objective is to locate and finalize the purchase of one or more existing enterprises or their significant assets. This can be accomplished through a variety of strategic methods, including a corporate merger, the exchange of capital stock, the outright acquisition of assets, a direct stock purchase, or a company-wide reorganization.
